name: Wineskins
overview: The Scriptures use the imagery of wineskins and garments to illustrate the incompatibility of mixing new and old in spiritual life. Luke 5:37 warns that new wine must be put into new wineskins to prevent bursting and loss, symbolizing the need for renewed hearts to receive fresh revelation. Similarly, Mark 2:21 emphasizes that sewing new cloth onto old garments worsens the tear, highlighting the futility of trying to combine new spiritual truths with old frameworks. Psalms 119:83, though metaphorical, reflects perseverance in God's statutes amid trials, complementing the theme of enduring faithfulness amidst change.
